_notes: Default settings for the YARG Career Builder. Copied to settings.json on
first run if that file is missing. See README.md for full documentation.
The career structure (tiers) and career metadata are NOT stored here; they
are loaded from Template.preset (the default template, or a user-imported
YARG export) on first run. 'loaded_career' remembers the last loaded/built
career filename so it can be restored on startup.
'private' - any source allowed (Guitar Hero / Rock Band / other games / customs).
'public'  - HARD BLOCK: build is refused unless every selected song's source (icon)
is a general custom (type custom/charter) or YARC launcher content (yarg/yargdlc/yarn).
source_selection.filter: list of source icon ids (e.g. "ghwt", "gh3", "c3customs"). Empty = all sources.
source_selection.limit: cap on the number of distinct sources used (0 = unlimited).
source_selection.weights: OPTIONAL. If non-empty it OVERRIDES filter/limit.
difficulty.field: song.ini key used to sort (e.g. diff_guitar, diff_band, diff_drums, diff_vocals).
difficulty.missing: 'last' puts songs with that difficulty == -1 (or missing) at the end; 'skip' drops them.
yarg.install_dir: YARG install folder (the one containing YARG.exe). Leave "" to auto-detect.
output_dir: where built .json/.preset careers are written. Leave "" to write
